spec2def(sfc.dll sfc.spec)

# sfc.dll is all Rust (sfc-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/sfc-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# sfc.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sfc-rust/src/sfc/sfc.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(sfc_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(sfc_shims PRIVATE libsfc_os libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(sfc sfc-cargo sfc.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE sfc-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS sfc_shims)
